title: Fynaptix · Space Economy Research
heading: Space Economy Intelligence
subheading: Launch, satellites, constellations & the post-SpaceX-IPO landscape
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Space is capital-intensive with heavy government-customer concentration. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: SpaceX's first earnings after the June IPO beat ($12.7B consensus) as AI ('Super Intelligence') hit $7.56B, now ~52% of revenue, and Starlink connectivity grew 69% to $5.25B; but Q3 capex was $19.6B and Q4 is guided to $35–40B, mostly AI, so it is increasingly not a pure space story.

kpis.sub: SPCX AFTER Q3 PRINT · VS $225.64 JUNE HIGH · LOCKUPS CONTINUE
kpis.label: Shares jumped ~8–10% after the Oct 20 print (about $154 premarket Oct 22, ~$147.50 later) and Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to study a merger; supply remains heavy, with a large post-earnings tranche eligible Oct 22, 328.4M shares Oct 24 and ~797.6M around Dec 8 (third-party schedule, verify against the prospectus).

kpis.sub: RKLB OCT 23 CLOSE · ~40% BELOW APR 20 · Q3 REPORT NOV 9
kpis.label: Rocket Lab's Neutron debut slipped into 2027 (Oct 14); Q2 revenue was $234.1M (+62%) with a $2.36B backlog and Q3 guided to $250–265M. Iridium beat its Q3 estimates (EPS $0.98 vs $0.34, revenue $245.7M) and holders approved the $8B deal, which is guided to close mid-2027.

kpis.sub: Q3 2026 PRIVATE SPACE INVESTMENT · RECORD QUARTER
kpis.label: Seraphim counts 216 deals in Q3 (median $9.8M) versus $7.4B in Q2; Blue Origin's ~$10B round is nearly half the total, so excluding it the quarter is still ~$10.8B. Blue Origin said Oct 16 that Florida infrastructure investment has passed $3B.

tiers.label: Scale Players
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Q3 revenue $14.58B (+161%), net income $4.4B, adjusted EBITDA $8.8B; Starlink connectivity $5.25B (+69%) with ARPU about $69 and ~13.6M consumer subscribers (press reports); Starship flew its first revenue mission in September and Flight 15 is expected in November, attempting booster and ship catches.
rows.watch for: Q3 capex of $19.6B and a $35–40B Q4 guide (mostly AI), continued lockup supply (Oct 22, Oct 24, ~Dec 8), unresolved Tesla merger talks (no terms, shareholder vote needed) and Starshield political risk. Shares ~$148–154 after the print.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $234.1M (+62%), backlog $2.36B (+137%), Q3 revenue guided to $250–265M; the $8B Iridium deal is approved by Iridium holders and guided to close mid-2027 (Iridium itself beat Q3 estimates on Oct 20).
rows.watch for: Neutron slipped to 2027 (at least the third delay); shares closed $52.60 on Oct 23, ~40% below Apr 20; Q3 results Nov 9 (adjusted EBITDA guided to a $17–23M loss), and FCC review of Iridium.

rows.angle: Space and Mission Systems anchored by 18 of the 36 satellites in the SDA's $1.75B Tranche 3 tracking-layer award (July) and the $4.7B PAC-3 propulsion award; shares were ~$248 in mid-October.
rows.watch for: Q3 earnings Oct 29 (consensus EPS ~$3.01, revenue ~$5.86B); the market has not credited the awards since July. Also sits in the Defense sleeve — don't double-count exposure.

tiers.label: Growth / Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: 13 BlueBirds in orbit, ~45 targeted by early 2027; $1.3B contracted backlog and >$3.7B pro forma liquidity; Deutsche Bank upgraded to Buy (Oct 12) while Piper Sandler cut to Neutral (Oct 13, target $54).
rows.watch for: Q2 revenue $31.5M missed ($34.4M est.) with a $0.77 loss per share, including $125.9M tied to the BB7 launch incident; SpaceX's spectrum deal and direct-to-cell push are direct competition; shares ~$40, roughly half their Apr 20 level.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $206.2M (more than 4x), record ~$1.76B backlog and a reaffirmed $900M–$1B 2026 revenue outlook; shares ~$10.5–11.1 after a +5% day on Oct 21.
rows.watch for: Net loss widened to $62.8M, equity is about −$290M, ~$259M of net insider selling over 12 months, and backlog conversion; shares ~60% below Apr 20.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $116.05M (+58%, beat), fifth straight EPS beat, adjusted EBITDA $13.9M; part of Google's Project Suncatcher prototype and won a NASA Tanager task order.
rows.watch for: Shares ~$13.4–13.9, ~63% below Apr 20; Barclays' $17 target (Equal Weight) implies limited upside; dependence on SpaceX rideshare capacity and founder stock sales.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $117.07M (beat), record $542M backlog, book-to-bill 1.42, 2026 revenue target $450–500M; one of 15 NITE STAR vendors and a Roll-Out Solar Array supplier to Axiom.
rows.watch for: Adjusted EBITDA still −$3.2M, NITE STAR carries no guaranteed revenue, Axiom's module is years out (2028), heavy insider selling; shares ~$8.4–8.6.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $33.3M (+50%, beat) with positive adjusted EBITDA of $4.7M; geospatial intelligence tied to defense and intelligence demand.
rows.watch for: GAAP loss of $0.54 per share (miss) including a $10.5M derivatives loss; shares ~54% below Apr 20; full-year revenue against $130–150M guidance.

private_watchlist.name: Blue Origin
private_watchlist.note: Reported ~$10B raise at a ~$130B valuation (its first outside round, described as oversubscribed). On Oct 16 it announced a $330M Rocket Park phase at Cape Canaveral with two more New Glenn pads, saying Florida investment has passed $3B; New Glenn returns to flight after the May pad explosion at LC-36 — year-end 2026 per some reports, early 2027 per Blue Origin's own update — with multi-vehicle operations targeted for summer 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Firefly Aerospace
private_watchlist.note: Already public, so it is outside the private groups; no fresh company news found this week. Alpha Flight 7 succeeded in March after the 2025 failure, and analysts expected about $446M of 2026 sales with profits not before 2027. Not given a stance here for lack of current data.

private_watchlist.name: Stoke Space
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week beyond the earlier $1B Series E (total raised $2.3B); Nova Block 2, a fully reusable design, remains targeted for 2029.

bear_case.title: Capital intensity
bear_case.description: SpaceX spent $19.6B of capex in Q3 and guides $35–40B for Q4, mostly for AI; Rocket Lab still guides to a $17–23M Q3 adjusted EBITDA loss while funding an $8B Iridium deal; Blue Origin needed a ~$10B raise. Funding is abundant now, but the sector depends on it staying that way.

bear_case.title: Government concentration
bear_case.description: The SDA's Tranche 3 tracking awards ($1.75B across L3Harris and Sierra Space in July) and Redwire's NITE STAR slot (one of 15 vendors, no guaranteed revenue) show how much revenue hangs on a few federal programs. Starshield restrictions in Ukraine show a single operator's decisions can become a geopolitical issue.

bear_case.title: SpaceX dominance and supply overhang
bear_case.description: SPCX is ~35% below its June high even after the earnings pop, with lockup tranches on Oct 22, Oct 24 and around Dec 8, and a possible Tesla merger adds uncertainty; its spectrum purchase and Starlink Mobile put it directly against AST SpaceMobile, and AI is now over half its revenue, so owning it is no longer a clean space exposure.

bear_case.title: Binary mission risk and schedule slips
bear_case.description: Neutron's first launch slipped into 2027 (at least the third delay), AST had a BB7 launch incident and has 13 satellites against a ~45 target, New Glenn is grounded until year-end or early 2027, and Starship's catch and refuelling remain unproven (Flight 15 expected in November). Mid-cap space shares are 40–63% below their Apr 20 levels.

catalysts.title: Piper Sandler cuts AST SpaceMobile to Neutral
catalysts.description: Cited SpaceX's direct-to-cell push and launch cadence; ASTS fell ~9% that day while Deutsche Bank upgraded to Buy a day earlier.

catalysts.title: Blue Origin outlines $330M Florida expansion
catalysts.description: Two more New Glenn pads and a customer integration facility; Florida investment passes $3B, with return to flight now guided to year-end or early 2027.

catalysts.title: SpaceX Q3: revenue $14.6B (+161%), net income $4.4B
catalysts.description: Beat on revenue and EPS ($0.35 vs $0.13 est.); AI segment $7.56B, Starlink connectivity $5.25B, Q4 capex guided to $35–40B. Shares rose ~8–10% and lifted LUNR, PL and RDW +4–5% on Oct 21.

catalysts.title: SpaceX and Tesla form merger special committees
catalysts.description: Musk said both boards formed independent committees to study a combination; no terms agreed and any deal needs shareholder approval.

catalysts.title: Iridium beats Q3 estimates
catalysts.description: EPS $0.98 vs $0.34 expected, revenue $245.7M (+8%), helped by the Aireon reacquisition; IRDM ~$44.40 and RKLB $52.60 on Oct 23, with the Rocket Lab deal guided to close mid-2027.

catalysts.title: SpaceX lockup tranches
catalysts.description: A post-earnings tranche became eligible Oct 22 and up to 328.4M shares on Oct 24, with ~797.6M more around Dec 8 (third-party schedule; verify against the prospectus).

catalysts.title: Upcoming: L3Harris, Rocket Lab earnings and Starship Flight 15
catalysts.description: L3Harris reports Q3 on Oct 29; Rocket Lab reports Q3 on Nov 9 after the close; SpaceX expects Starship Flight 15 in November, attempting booster and ship catches.

etfs.name: Procure Space
etfs.summary: Pure-play, revenue-weighted (RKLB, PL, ASTS among top holdings); traded ~$40.7 on Oct 21 (+3% that day) and ~$39.9 later, tracking the weakness in the mid-cap names.

etfs.name: ARK Space Exploration
etfs.summary: Actively managed with broader tech adjacency; ARK has commented that Neutron comes close to Falcon 9 on payload, and the fund's results depend heavily on a handful of high-beta holdings. No fresh fund data found this week.

etfs.name: SPDR Kensho Final Frontiers
etfs.summary: Equal-weight blend of space, defense and deep-sea names; the defense-adjacent holdings (like L3Harris) cushion it versus pure-plays, though L3Harris itself has lagged since July. No fresh fund data found this week.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: Rocket Lab
positions.note: Neutron's slip into 2027 and a ~40% drawdown to $52.60 hurt sentiment, but Q2 revenue of $234.1M (+62%), a $2.36B backlog and Q3 guidance of $250–265M (reported Nov 9) keep the Electron-led business intact.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: 18 of the 36 satellites in the SDA's $1.75B tracking award and the $4.7B PAC-3 propulsion award underpin the backlog, with Q3 earnings on Oct 29 the next test. Also sits in the Defense sleeve — don't double-count exposure.

positions.name: Planet Labs
positions.note: Q2 revenue of $116.05M (+58%), a fifth straight EPS beat and $13.9M adjusted EBITDA are the best fundamentals among the small caps, but ~$13.4 is still 63% below April and Barclays' $17 target shows limited upside.

positions.name: Intuitive Machines
positions.note: Q2 revenue of $206.2M and a $1.76B backlog are real, yet a $62.8M net loss, negative equity of about $290M and ~$259M of insider selling keep it small at ~$10.5.

positions.name: AST SpaceMobile
positions.note: A Q2 revenue miss ($31.5M vs $34.4M), a $125.9M loss tied to the BB7 launch incident, Piper Sandler's downgrade and SpaceX's spectrum push outweigh $1.3B of backlog at ~$40 — moved from speculative to watch.

positions.name: Redwire
positions.note: A $542M record backlog and a Q2 beat ($117.1M revenue) are encouraging, but adjusted EBITDA is still −$3.2M, NITE STAR carries no guaranteed revenue and insiders have been heavy sellers at ~$8.4.

positions.name: BlackSky
positions.note: Q2 revenue of $33.3M (+50%) with positive adjusted EBITDA of $4.7M is good progress, but a GAAP loss of $0.54 per share and a ~54% drop since April leave the earnings quality unresolved.

positions.name: SpaceX
positions.note: Q3 revenue of $14.6B (+161%) and $4.4B net income are strong, but AI is now over half of revenue, Q4 capex is guided to $35–40B and lockup tranches continue through Dec 8 at ~$148–154. UK investors wanting indirect exposure can use Scottish Mortgage (SMT, covered on the Baillie Gifford page).

positions.name: Iridium Communications
positions.note: Q3 EPS of $0.98 vs $0.34 expected was a clean beat, but at $44.40 the stock is pinned to Rocket Lab's slide with the deal not closing until mid-2027 — RKLB remains the cleaner way to express the view.
